craft.sentence: 短句推进；对话承载打脸；少风景描写
craft.stance: 爽点优先，正义报复清晰，不阴湿虐主
craft.opening: 开场即羞辱场景或身份错位
craft.avoid: 文艺独白、无节制修罗场、主角无脑圣母
craft.lexicon: 目光一凝、众人哗然、你算什么、下一章见

referenceParagraph.zh: 门口保安拦住他时，大厅里刚好有人起哄。他没解释，只把旧证件往桌上一拍——反响比骂声来得更快。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 门口保安拦住他时，大厅里刚好有人起哄。他没解释，只把旧证件往桌上一拍——反响比骂声来得更快。
referenceParagraph.en: Security stopped him as the lobby jeered. He slapped an old ID on the desk—the room turned faster than the insults.
referenceParagraph.ja: Security stopped him as the lobby jeered. He slapped an old ID on the desk—the room turned faster than the insults.

craft.sentence: 数字与清单清楚；对话刺对方势利

craft.opening: 先给一个被低估的价格或机会

referenceParagraph.zh: 他把报价单折好，推回去：「这个价，留给还在看笑话的人。」旁桌笑声停了一拍。

referenceParagraph.ja: He folded the quote back: “Leave that price for the people still laughing.” The next table went quiet.

referenceParagraph.zh: 电梯门开时两人都停了一秒。他先把伞递过去：「下雨了。合同的事，出来再说。」

craft.sentence: 短句冷；长句只用于崩溃瞬间

referenceParagraph.ja: He slid the folder to the center: “Annex three isn’t original. You don’t want a signature—you want time.”
